rewrite.text: A red fox is curled up and sleeping in a field of tall grass. The fox's body forms a compact, rounded shape in the center of the frame. Its fur is a dense coat of vibrant orange and red tones, with lighter, almost white fur visible on its chest and the lower part of its face. The fox's head rests on the ground, turned slightly to its right. Its eyes are closed, indicated by thin, dark lines. A small, black nose is visible at the end of its snout. Two pointed ears stand erect; they are orange with prominent black tips and a hint of white fur on their inner surfaces. The fox is nestled in a bed of grass that is a mix of dry, pale yellow stalks and some shorter, green blades. The ground immediately around the fox is in sharp focus, while the foreground and background are heavily blurred. The foreground is a soft, out-of-focus wash of golden-yellow grass. The background is a dark, indistinct area of deep greens and browns, suggesting distant foliage in shadow. Scattered throughout the upper portion of the background are numerous bright, circular bokeh highlights, which are out-of-focus points of light, appearing as soft, glowing orbs of warm yellow and white. The entire scene is bathed in a warm, low-angled light that illuminates the fox's fur and the tips of the grass. telephoto bokeh.
